findings.title: Global router does not union standard and trigger-mapped lenses
findings.resolution_required: Use the official five-lens router gate plus fail-closed security/authorization fields in the same digest-bound receipt without modifying out-of-scope global skills.

findings.title: Load-bearing test plan is outside the Contract Matrix
findings.resolution_required: Add the test plan to complete matrix inventory and keep authoritative cases in tracked Tasks/Delta.

findings.title: Delivery reconciliation invalidates frozen candidate evidence
findings.resolution_required: Complete all delivery-file reconciliation before the final candidate freeze and rerun every candidate gate afterward.

findings.title: Hostile-Origin GET and OPTIONS matrix is incomplete
findings.resolution_required: Add hostile GET/OPTIONS, trusted OPTIONS and no-Origin CLI GET/mutation/OPTIONS with headers and next/effect assertions.

findings.title: Broad date wording ambiguously includes UTC audit timestamps
findings.resolution_required: Narrow projection to calendar labels/buckets and explicitly preserve full UTC ISO audit timestamps.

findings.title: Parser, route, provider and DB zero-effect seam is underspecified
findings.resolution_required: Extract/test middleware next independently and combine malformed JSON, provider spy, DB before/after and all-route enumeration.

findings.title: Qualified SQL identifier grammar is not exact
findings.resolution_required: Specify and test the exact component regex including leading/consecutive/trailing-dot rejection.

findings.title: Duplicate additional-origin collision semantics are ambiguous
findings.resolution_required: Define trim/parse/canonical comparison order and reject duplicates including built-in collisions.

summary: Trusted initial O3 review rejected the first contract. One consolidated Owner artifact fix is required before a fresh seven-lens closer.
